title: In Opex week, only London keeps its range

hero.caption: That's all **London**'s range gives up in Opex week — basically flat. Asia collapses (−14%) and NY tightens (−6%); London is the one session that stays alive.

chart.label: Range in Opex week vs the rest of the month
chart.sub: Below the dotted line = tighter range than a normal week
chart.note: Every session tightens in Opex week — except London, which trades its normal range.

useIt: If you trade Opex week, London is where the range survives. Asia gets pinned and NY is a touch quieter — don't expect big overnight moves outside the London session.
disclaimer: Not advice · AI-backtested on 10y NQ · check it yourself
